Added replacement for HAL_UART_DMAStop to remove hardware dependencies. The function contains ATOMIC_CLEAR_BIT operations that use ARM-specific atomic instructions and calls DMA abort functions which have hardware dependencies. The new implementation:
1. Removes all hardware-specific operations (ATOMIC_CLEAR_BIT, HAL_IS_BIT_SET, HAL_DMA_Abort)
2. Simply restores the UART state to READY if it was busy
3. Resets transfer counters
4. Returns HAL_OK to maintain compatibility
This allows the function to work correctly in emulation without hardware dependencies and prevents potential issues with atomic operations and DMA calls.
